stories.title: Blast near Delhi's Red Fort on 10 November
stories.body: a Hyundai i20 exploded near Gate 1 of the Red Fort Metro Station, killing 13 people; the case was registered under the UAPA and the Explosives Act with a multi-agency investigation.
